Create this BONUS deliverable to the 80/20 bar — usable tools first, minimal teaching, right-sized to solve ONE specific problem. Everything specific to this exact niche and audience — real fill-in content, the words this audience actually uses. No generic filler, no padding.

The reader has already enrolled in "The Pin Programme" — write to a buyer on the inside who is ready to execute, not a prospect you are trying to convert.

Lead magnet title (the promise to deliver on): "The Pin Toolkit"
MUST-MATCH BRIEF — the deliverable already advertised to the buyer; the content you produce must deliver exactly this, not a re-interpretation of the title: Pin brief.
Niche / audience: Pin niche
Paid programme name (what nextStep bridges to): The Pin Programme
Main benefit of the paid offer: Pin benefit
UPSTREAM CONTEXT — PIN
Offer context: Pin offer description.
Audience pains: Pin pains.
Audience goals: Pin goals.
What blocks them from acting: Pin barriers.
Brand context: Pin brand context.

Write about the approach in plain descriptive terms, using only the situation, audience and outcome given above.

Begin with a "howToUse": 2-4 sentences stating plainly what this document is, how to use it, and what it achieves. Then a TIGHT promise: max two sentences on what they can DO with this. End with a nextStep that helps them put this to work and get the most from "The Pin Programme" — a heading, a short body orienting them to the next action inside the programme they have joined, and a concrete ctaLabel about USING it (for example "Start With Step 1"). No dead end.

Produce a GUIDE: 3-6 solution-focused sections, each a clear heading and lean, directly-actionable content (steps, a mini-framework, an example the reader applies) — not padded prose. Useful beats comprehensive.
Write each section to about 200 words. Where a section carries a usable artefact — a fill-in template, a checklist, swipe copy — give the artefact the room and keep the teaching around it to a line or two.
Return JSON: { "howToUse", "promise", "sections":[{"heading","body"}], "nextStep":{"heading","body","ctaLabel"} }.
